home_subtitle: 单元提升 · 语法写作阅读
part1_desc: 第 1–27 步：翻译帮学 some/any，教材帮学复合不定代词，练习帮读自编精讲短文练语法。
part2_desc: 第 28–50 步：读马克·吐温小传与短文填空短文，练写作方法与固定结构法，写作帮练写人物条目。
note: 本课为 Unit 1 单元提升，阅读材料为教研自编，非课本原文。考查能力：some/any 与复合不定代词（some-类/any-类/no(-)类/every-类、主语单数、定语后置、部分否定）、写作方法（介绍人物四步、第三人称、一般过去时）、中考短文填空固定结构法（be supposed to、be proud of、one of the + 最高级、is/the/of 固定搭配）、马克·吐温事实（1835 年生于佛罗里达乡下、4 岁搬进城、12 岁父亲去世、从小工作、《汤姆·索亚历险记》、作品取材个人经历）。

steps.title: 最后一站：单元提升
steps.teach_html:
广播站的单元提升站开播：Unit 1 单元提升。站长苏文说：这一单元我们走了四站——阅读、语法、口语、文化。这一课把语法、写作、中考阅读三件事收一收。

先记住本单元的大问题：What can we learn from encyclopaedias? 我们能从百科全书中学到什么？学会查它，就是学会自己找答案。

steps.title: 翻译帮：some 与 any（一）
steps.teach_html:
some 和 any 都表示“一些”，都可以修饰可数名词复数和不可数名词。不同点是用的句子不一样：

some 用于肯定句：There are some people in the room. 房间里有一些人。

any 用于否定句和疑问句：I don't have any money. 我没有钱。Do you have any chocolate cakes? 你有巧克力蛋糕吗？

记住：肯定句里一般用 some，否定句和疑问句里一般用 any。

steps.title: 翻译帮：some 与 any（二）
steps.teach_html:
两个特别用法要记牢：

1. some 也用于提出建议或请求的疑问句，表示希望得到对方的肯定答复：Would you like some rice? 你想来点米饭吗？Can I have some milk, Mum? 妈妈，我能喝点牛奶吗？

2. any 在肯定句里强调“任何一个”：You can take any box on the table. 你可以拿桌上的任何一个盒子。

还有一条：如果含有 some 的肯定句变成否定句或疑问句，一般要把 some 换成 any。

steps.title: 教材帮：复合不定代词一张表
steps.teach_html:
复合不定代词是由 some、any、no、every 加上 -body、(-)one、-thing 构成的：

-body：somebody 某人、anybody 任何人、nobody 没有人、everybody 每人。

(-)one：someone 某人、anyone 任何人、no one 没有人、everyone 每人。

-thing：something 某事、anything 任何东西、nothing 没有什么、everything 每件事、一切。

它们都有名词的性质，在句中可以作主语、宾语或表语，但不能作定语——不能放在名词前面修饰名词。

steps.title: 教材帮：复合不定代词用法（一）
steps.teach_html:
some-类复合不定代词常用于肯定句：There is something wrong with my bike. 我的自行车出问题了。

any-类常用于否定句和疑问句：The old lady couldn't see anything at all. 那位老太太什么都看不见。Is there anyone at home? 家里有人吗？

在表示请求、邀请、建议并希望得到对方肯定回答的疑问句中，要用 some-类：Would you like something to drink? 你想喝点什么吗？

anything 表示“任何事物”、anyone/anybody 表示“无论谁，任何人”时，也可以用在肯定句里：You can buy anything you want. 你可以买任何你想要的东西。

steps.title: 教材帮：复合不定代词用法（二）
steps.teach_html:
三条注意事项：

1. 作主语时，谓语动词用单数：Everyone wants to have a long holiday. 人人都想有一个长假期。

2. 定语要后置：被形容词、不定式、else 等修饰时，定语放在后面：I want to buy something special for my grandmother. 我想给奶奶买些特别的东西。Ask somebody else to help you. 请别人来帮你吧。

3. every-类 + 否定 = 部分否定：Not everyone knows her. 不是所有人都认识她。全部否定要用 no(-)类，或在否定句中用 any-类：Nobody knows her. 没有人认识她。There isn't anyone in the classroom. 教室里没有人。

steps.title: 翻译帮：写作方法——介绍人物四步
steps.teach_html:
写介绍人物、动物、景观的文章，可以按这几方面展开。介绍某位名人：

① 简要介绍基本信息：出生年份、出生地、职业。

② 详细介绍生平、主要成就：他经历了什么，做了什么了不起的事。

③ 表达个人观点及感受：你为什么钦佩他，他给你什么启发。

审题记住四点：以第三人称写为主；时态以一般过去时为主；体裁是百科全书条目；要点是名字、职业、人物生平及成就。

steps.title: 教材帮：写人物常用句式
steps.teach_html:
写人物条目，这些句式可以直接用：

基本信息：Mark Twain was one of the great American writers in the 19th century. 马克·吐温是 19 世纪伟大的美国作家之一。

生平经历：He was born in... and moved to... 他出生在……，后来搬到……。When he was... years old, he... 当他……岁时，他……。He had to start working from an early age and tried many different kinds of jobs. 他不得不从很小的时候就开始工作，尝试过许多不同种类的工作。

主要成就：He wrote many great novels and one of the most famous ones is... 他写过许多伟大的小说，其中最著名的一部是……。Most of his writings were based on his personal experiences. 他的大部分作品都基于个人经历。

steps.title: 教材帮：中考短文填空固定结构法
steps.teach_html:
英语短文填空题常考固定短语、句型或搭配。做题方法：

第一步：通读全文，理解大意，判断空处所在句子要表达的意思。

第二步：锁定固定搭配的类型，再根据时态、人称填合适的形式。

三个固定结构要记牢：be 动词作谓语（it is important to tell the truth 说真话很重要）；最高级前加 the（the most famous story 最有名的故事）；be proud of（为……自豪）。

steps.title: 翻译帮：阅读材料——some/any 精讲短文
steps.teach_html:
下面是一段自编短文，把 some、any 和复合不定代词的规则讲全了。读两遍，记住：some 用在哪？any 用在哪？复合不定代词作主语，谓语用什么数？定语放在哪里？

读的时候把规则和例句对上：每个规则后面都跟了一个例句。

steps.title: 练习帮：some 用在哪里
steps.scene: some 通常用在哪里？
steps.stem: Where do we usually use 'some'?
steps.help: 想想规则：some 用于肯定句，还是否定句？
steps.explain: We usually use 'some' in positive sentences. some 通常用于肯定句。

wrong_feedback.B: 否定句里一般用 any，不用 some。
wrong_feedback.C: 一般疑问句里一般用 any，不用 some。
wrong_feedback.D: some 是常用词，不是从来不用。

steps.reading: Some and any both mean '一些'. We use some in positive sentences. There are some people in the room. We use any in negative sentences and questions. I don't have any money. Do you have any chocolate cakes? We also use some in questions when we ask for something and we hope the answer is yes. Can I have some milk, Mum? Would you like some rice? In positive sentences, any can mean '任何一个'. You can take any box on the table. Now look at compound indefinite pronouns. We make them with some, any, no and every plus -body, -one or -thing. Somebody is waiting for you. Is there anyone at home? I have nothing to say. Everything is ready. These words are pronouns. They can be the subject or the object of a sentence, but they cannot be used before a noun. When they are the subject, the verb is singular. Everyone wants to have a long holiday. When an adjective comes after them, it goes after the word. I want to buy something special for my grandmother.

steps.title: 翻译帮：阅读材料——马克·吐温小传
steps.teach_html:
第二段短文分两部分：前面是自编的马克·吐温小传，后面是一段自编的中考短文填空练习短文《龟兔赛跑》。读两遍，记住：马克·吐温生于哪一年、哪里？4 岁、12 岁发生了什么？他最著名的小说是什么？

读短文填空那段时，先通读全文理解大意，再看三个空分别要填什么固定结构。

steps.scene: 马克·吐温是什么人？
steps.stem: Who was Mark Twain?
options: a Chinese scientist who worked on hybrid rice
a great American writer in the 19th century
steps.help: 回到小传第一句找：He was a great...
steps.explain: Mark Twain was a great American writer in the 19th century. 马克·吐温是 19 世纪伟大的美国作家。

wrong_feedback.A: 中国科学家是袁隆平，不是马克·吐温。
wrong_feedback.C: 法国画家不是马克·吐温。
wrong_feedback.D: 英国歌手不是马克·吐温。

steps.reading: Mark Twain was a great American writer. He lived in the 19th century, and he was one of the best writers of his time. He was born in 1835, in the countryside of Florida. When he was four, his family moved to the city. When he was twelve, his father died. He started to work when he was very young, and he tried many different jobs. He wrote many famous novels. One of the most famous is The Adventures of Tom Sawyer. Most of his stories came from his own life, so they feel real. Millions of people read his books every year. Now read a short passage about a story. The Tortoise and the Hare. This is a wonderful story everyone should know. We are supposed to learn from it. It tells us that slow and steady wins the race. This might be the most famous animal story of all. It tells us that we should be proud of who we are, even if we are not the fastest. The hare is fast, but he is not the winner. The tortoise is slow, but he keeps going. In the end, the tortoise wins. It is important to keep going and never give up.

steps.title: 写作帮：介绍人物四步 + 范文要点
steps.teach_html:
写介绍人物的条目，按这四步走：

第 1 步：基本信息。Mark Twain was one of the great American writers in the 19th century. He was born in the countryside of Florida in 1835.

第 2 步：生平经历。When he was four years old, his family moved to the city. When he was twelve, his father died. He had to start working from an early age and tried many different kinds of jobs.

第 3 步：主要成就。He wrote many great novels and one of the most famous ones is The Adventures of Tom Sawyer. Most of his writings were based on his personal experiences.

第 4 步：个人感受。His stories are read by millions of people every year. I admire him because his stories are full of real feelings.

注意：以第三人称写为主，时态以一般过去时为主，100 词左右。

steps.title: 练习帮：写人物先写什么
steps.scene: 写介绍人物的条目，第一步写什么？
steps.stem: What do you write first in an entry about a person?
options: A very long list of opinions about his whole life story
Basic information: year of birth, birthplace and job
steps.help: 介绍人物四步，第一步是什么？
steps.explain: First, write basic information: year of birth, birthplace and job. 先写基本信息：出生年份、出生地、职业。

wrong_feedback.A: 个人感受是第四步，不是第一步。
wrong_feedback.B: 条目里写事实，不写一长串观点。

steps.title: 本课小结
steps.teach_html:
这一课我们学了：

1. 翻译帮：some 用于肯定句，any 用于否定句和疑问句；some-类、any-类、no(-)类、every-类复合不定代词；作主语谓语用单数，定语后置。

2. 写作帮：介绍人物四步——基本信息、生平经历、主要成就、个人感受；第三人称、一般过去时为主。

3. 教材帮：中考短文填空固定结构法——先通读全文，再锁定固定搭配：be 动词作谓语、最高级前加 the、be proud of。

Unit 1 学完了：Section 1 阅读、Section 2 语法、Section 3 口语写作、Section 4 文化跨学科。下个单元，继续查下去！
